purpose: Bounded real joint-state matched-learning development before any expansion/generalization. Not final fresh-lineage or independent confirmation evidence.
identity_model_selection: Lexicographically first old outer sequence dancetrack0001, first registered historical seed72101; fixed before new corpus effects, never best observed checkpoint.
episodes: At most3 actual first eligible identities per historical scene, sorted first eligible frame then sequence-local GT ID; width>=16,height>=48. Sole event-frame RGB OSNet crop only. Reuse an old anchor only for exact identity/frame/box and matching encoder SHA. Missing initial real candidate is explicit initialization failure, no replacement target.
mixed_training: Pool real baseline, treatment, delayed and round0 histories without GT replacing their past states.
sampling: Prospective deterministic original-frame schedule: event+16 and every128 frames afterward, at most16 event positions per source/episode. No effect- or GT-correctness-based frame choice.
action_proposals: KEEP, REJECT, plus highest two immutable raw-anchor and highest ACIB candidate probability real UIDs excluding own KEEP, deduplicated, stable UID tie-break; max3 non-KEEP candidate actions. Never GT-best action.
counterfactual_prestate: Clone the actual generating source's full joint tracker/identity/pending state. Exact solver unchanged; all owners committed, branches independently evolve under KEEP after one action.
features: Only current/past visual embeddings, immutable click, own joint scores/ownership/native/prototype/motion/gaps, identity candidate/NONE probabilities, causal pending counts. Store sealed candidate references, not duplicate embedding tape. Future TRAIN truth appears only in separate supervision files after all runtime branch seals.
risk_label: Any strictly lost KEEP-correct target frame, non-target KEEP-origin damage, or wrong/unverified write in the chosen horizon. UNKNOWN separately recorded; not declared verified-other.
default_value: (N01-N10) - non_target_damage + non_target_benefit - wrong_or_UNKNOWN_writes; retain each original component and alternate horizon labels. Not actual HOTA/AssA.
window_TrackEval: Actual bounded intervention-window same-setting HOTA/AssA diagnostics on deterministic first complete event per FIT sequence when resource budget permits; do not substitute proxy values for official metrics.
on_policy_rounds: Round0 fixed broad real policy; after new FIT-only fitting, at most2 further causal rollout/relabel rounds with policy checkpoint+SHA frozen first. No GT history substitution or loss-only closed-loop success claim.
resource_limits: Reuse venv/candidates/weights; CPU<=4, threads1, reserve60GiB; total stage artifacts<=8GiB, 1800s/case and3600s/fit. Preserve partial failures explicitly.
no_supervision_rule: If prospective corpus has no trainable verified benefit/harm diversity, retain actual raw labels and document insufficiency. Do not train meaningless success models; pursue authorized diagnostics/recovery/representation alternatives before whole-stage closure.
